Description: Monitoring well identifier as issued by the source agency (USGS, WQP, NGWMN or state agency).
Sampling date of the chloride observation (YYYY-MM-DD).
Two-letter U.S. state code. PA (85 wells) is included for completeness but was excluded from modeling.
Well longitude.
Well latitude.
Chloride concentration of the groundwater sample (target variable).
Total well depth below land surface.
Land-surface elevation at the well.
USGS principal aquifer or aquifer system.
Source: Principal Aquifers of the United States (USGS, 2003)

Description: Confinement class of the principal aquifer (confined, unconfined, mixed).
Planar distance from the well to the present-day (0 ft) NOAA inundation extent (land at or below MHHW, 1983–2001 epoch); 0 = inside the extent.
Source: NOAA Sea Level Rise Viewer extent rasters (NOAA, 2019)

Description: Planar distance from the well to the nearest surface-water body.
Planar distance from the well to the nearest mapped subsurface salt dome (Gulf Coast states only).
Source: Andrews (2023); Beckman & Williamson (1990); Schuba et al. (2025)

Description: Distance to the projected inundation extent under +4 ft (1.22 m) sea-level rise; SSP2-4.5 for Atlantic states, AL and MS.
Distance to the projected inundation extent under +5 ft (1.52 m); SSP2-4.5 for LA and TX.
Distance to the projected inundation extent under +7 ft (2.13 m); SSP5-8.5 for Atlantic states, AL and MS.
Distance to the projected inundation extent under +9 ft (2.74 m); SSP5-8.5 for LA and TX.
Precipitation on the sampling date.
Precipitation on the day before the sampling date; used in the projection-configuration search.
Cumulative precipitation over the 7 days preceding the sampling date.
Cumulative precipitation over the 30 days preceding the sampling date.
Depth to water below land surface at the time of sampling, positive downward; negative values indicate artesian conditions (water level above land surface).
Groundwater (water-level) elevation, computed as Surf_Ele − WaterLevel_m.
Daily mean water level at the nearest NOAA tide gauge on the sampling date, converted from MHHW to NAVD88.
Daily maximum water level at the nearest NOAA tide gauge on the sampling date, converted from MHHW to NAVD88.
Land-surface elevation above the daily mean tidal water level (Surf_Ele − Daily_Mean).
Land-surface elevation above the daily maximum tidal water level (Surf_Ele − Daily_Max).
Land-surface elevation above the mean tidal water level of the 365 days preceding the sampling date; predictor in the tide-referenced (TIDE) model.
